newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN AMATEUR FINDS JUDGE AS HARD AS REFEREE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN AMATEUR FINDS JUDGE AS HARD AS REFEREE.

text.p: An Italian amateur soccer player who had two teeth broken in a goalmouth clash and was sent off for protesting about the foul got even shorter shrift on Wednesday when he took his case to a judge.
The court in the northwest town of Aosta took just three minutes to rule that the foul on Stefano Giopp, 24, did not constitute a crime.
It threw out a charge of grievous bodily harm and a damages suit against rival player Adriano Perucca, 29, whom Giopp had reported to prosecutors after the incident in October 1994.
Lady Luck was no easier on Giopp's team, HoneArnad. They lost the match 7-0 to rivals LegaDoraBurolo.
